label: Human
description: Pauses the run until a person submits a form, then continues with their answers; use it for review or approval mid-run. A run that cannot pause, such as a route still answering its caller, holds its worker instead, up to its trigger's `holdSecs`, then fails saying it gave up. Each form field adds input and/or output ports by its kind.
